# Document

A document associated with an estate — wills, codicils, trust deeds, and other legal documents. Extension types use the x-inherit- prefix for jurisdiction-specific or religious document types

Source: [`v3/document.json`](../../v3/document.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/document.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this document within the INHERIT document |
| `type` | one of `will`, `codicil`, `trust_deed`, `power_of_attorney`, `death_certificate`, `grant_of_probate`, `letters_of_administration`, `marriage_certificate`, `divorce_decree`, `prenuptial_agreement`, `property_deed`, `valuation_report`, `tax_return`, `insurance_policy`, `deed_of_variation`, `family_settlement`, `other`, `invoice`, `receipt` or `string` | yes | The type of document. Core types cover common law and civil law documents. Extension types use the x-inherit- prefix |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Human-readable title of the document |
| `fileFormat` | `string` | | File format or extension. Use lowercase without a leading dot |
| `storageRef` | `string` | | Storage reference — an S3 URI, file path, external system reference, or document management system identifier |
| `fileSizeBytes` | `integer` | | File size in bytes. Zero for metadata-only entries where the document content is stored externally |
| `mimeType` | `string` | | MIME type of the document file |
| `createdAt` | `string` (date-time) | | Timestamp when the document was created or executed |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this document. Use for provenance, authenticity concerns, or handling instructions |
| `entityType` | `string` | | The type of entity this document relates to. Combined with entityId, creates a contextual link: 'this PDF is the valuation certificate for asset X' |
| `entityId` | `string` (uuid) | | The ID of the entity this document relates to. Combined with entityType, links the document to its subject |
| `content` | `string` | | Base64-encoded file content for self-contained documents. Use for small, critical files (wills, certificates, attestations) that must travel with the estate plan. For large files, use storageRef instead |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Scans or photographs of this document — useful when the original is a physical paper document |
| `clauses` | array of [WillClause](#def-WillClause) | | Structured clauses of a will or testamentary document — enables per-clause provenance tracking, succession regime tagging, and validating authority assignment |
| `formalityStatus` | one of `formal`, `informal_admitted`, `informal_contested`, `holographic`, `nuncupative`, `unknown` | | Whether the document meets strict formalities or was admitted under a curative/dispensing power |
| `formalityAdmittedBy` | `string` | | Court or authority that admitted the informal document |
| `formalityAdmittedAt` | `string` (date) | | |
| `formalityJurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | |
| `formalityNotes` | `string` | | Circumstances of informal execution |
| `registryReference` | `object` | | Structured reference to a government registry entry |
| `registrations` | array of `object` | | Registries where this document has been registered. Tracks will registration with services such as the National Will Register (England & Wales) or the Register of Deeds (Scotland). Maps to Schema.org RegisterAction |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-WillClause"></a>

### WillClause

A single clause within a will or testamentary document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this clause |
| `clauseNumber` | `integer` | | The clause number within the document |
| `title` | `string` | | Human-readable title of the clause |
| `content` | `string` | | The clause text |
| `relatedEntityIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | IDs of related entities — bequests, assets, people, etc |
| `successionRegime` | `object` | | The succession regime governing this clause |
| `provenance` | `object` | | Provenance information — who or what created this clause and who reviewed it |
| `validatingAuthority` | `object` | | The authority that must validate or has validated this clause |
